messages:
Alex: Quick FYI — seeing a small subset of requests land on v2 implicitly when the `x-redwood-api-version` header is missing. Console default is v2 for new projects, but routing is doing an implicit-affinity switch for some legacy clients :eyes:

Maya: Which errors are we seeing? 4xx or 5xx?

Alex: Mostly 400s, schema/param mismatches. Example log:
```
req_id=abc123 client=old-sdk status=400 err=UnknownParam "tools"
```
Only ~0.7% of traffic and concentrated on free-tier/mobile SDKs.

Cheng: Likely a telemetry blindspot — old SDKs don't send `client_version`. We currently attribute by `client_version` header.

Sam: Two levers here: (1) surface an explicit "implicit versioning" banner in the console + actionable pin, (2) change routing to keep a backward-compat fallback for affected project ids for a short window.

Ivy: Before changing routing, we should improve signals. Suggest bumping trace/sample rate for requests without `x-redwood-api-version` to 10% for 24h so we can ID client UA and SDK versions.

Alex: Agreed. Also flag on billing — v2 token accounting and pricing nuances may surprise customers if we switch them silently.

Maya: We should not change billing mid-flight. If we route implicit traffic to v2, show a billing grace (keep v1 pricing) for 48h for impacted projects and notify them.

Sam: Ops ask: can we add a circuit-breaker? Proposal: if v2 implicit error rate > 1% for a given project over 5m, auto-route back to v1 + trigger an alert.

Cheng: Add these telemetry tags: `implicit_version=1|2`, `no_version_header=true`, and increment `compat_fallback` counter. Also log `client_ua` and `x-sdk` where present to identify old releases.

Ivy: UX notes: banner copy should read something like: 'Requests without an API version header will default to v2. If your integration depends on v1 behavior, pin your API version in Project Settings or add `x-redwood-api-version: 1`.' Add a CTA in Project Settings to pin version.

Alex: I'll open the PR to bump sampling and add the new metrics tags. Can someone draft the banner copy and the exact billing grace language? @Maya? :pray: 

Maya: Draft copy below — happy to iterate:

'Requests that don't include an API version header will default to v2. If your integration depends on v1 behavior, pin your API version in Project Settings or add the header `x-redwood-api-version: 1`. We're investigating a small number of older SDKs that may be affected — contact support if you need an immediate exception.'

deploy-bot: deploy queued: sampling-config -> staging (sha: d6f2a) by Alex

Sam: After staging looks good, roll to prod with a 10% canary for 30m and monitor `implicit_v2_error_rate`.

Cheng: Dashboard action items: add chart 'Implicit-version errors by project' (group by `client_ua`) and alert rule: `implicit_v2_error_rate > 0.01` sustained for 5m. Also surface a table of top 50 impacted project ids.

Ivy: Also add a tooltip in the Project Settings UI about billing differences and link to the migration doc and pricing FAQ.

Maya: I'll coordinate with Growth on the banner A/B test and the support messaging.

Alex: Action items recap: Alex — sampling PR + small routing probe; Cheng — metrics + dashboards + alert; Sam — rollout/circuit config; Maya — banner + billing grace copy; Ivy — pin-version CTA in settings. Revisit in 3h.

Sam: +1. Ping me when staging deploy is green.

Alex: Thanks — will update thread after the canary starts. :thumbsup:
